description: Search publicly discoverable WEIR AI identity licenses. Use when a user wants to find publicly listed likeness licensing options (e.g. for a campaign). Returns entries with license type, verification status and terms_url for reading the rights holder's published terms. Optional: search (text), license_type, limit 1-100, offset. 'Anonymous' names are a rights-holder privacy choice. Search results do not establish permission. Next step: get_public_license for one entry. To check one named person's clearance, use check_identity instead. [Public, no account needed]

license_type.description: Filter by license type. Call license_types to learn what each means.

search.description: Free-text search over names and license titles.
